messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

First, the Manager checks the open leads. Afterwards, he selects the top five ones. He then tells his Sales Assistant to call the contact person of the leads. The Sales Assistant calls each customer. If someone is interested, he sends a note to the Manager. The Manager then processes the lead. Otherwise, he calls the next customer.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="LeadProcessingProcess" name="Lead Processing Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckLeads" name="Check open leads">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectTopFive" name="Select top five leads">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TellAssistant" name="Tell Sales Assistant to call contacts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_CallCustomers" name="Call Customers Loop">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EndLoop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="SubStart_1">
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CallCustomer" name="Call customer">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interested" name="Interested?">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_2</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_No</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SendNote" name="Send note to Manager">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SubFlow_ToManager</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_Continue" name="Next Customer">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_No</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_NoteSent" name="Note Sent">
        <bpmn:incoming>SubFlow_ToManager</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessLead" name="Process the lead">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcessLead</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    
    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_CheckLeads" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckLeads" targetRef="Task_SelectTopFive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectTopFive" targetRef="Task_TellAssistant" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_TellAssistant" targetRef="SubProcess_CallCustomers" />
    
    <!-- Subprocess Internal Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_1" sourceRef="SubStart_1" targetRef="Task_CallCustomer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_2" sourceRef="Task_CallCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_Interested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="Task_SendNote" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="SubEnd_Continue" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_ToManager" sourceRef="Task_SendNote" targetRef="SubEnd_NoteSent" />

    <!-- Linking Subprocess Output to Main Process Logic -->
    <!-- Note: In strict BPMN, a subprocess doesn't automatically pass control out based on internal end events without specific boundary events or multi-instance logic. 
         However, to model "If interested -> Send Note -> Manager Processes", we need an explicit flow from the 'Note Sent' state to the Manager's task.
         Since standard BPMN requires a single outgoing flow from a non-interrupting event or subprocess completion, 
         we will model the loop as a Multi-Instance Task for clarity and correctness in execution, 
         but given the prompt's narrative style, a simplified linear flow with a gateway outside is often expected in simple diagrams.
         
         Let's refine the structure to be strictly valid BPMN 2.0 XML that represents the logic:
         The "Call Customers" is a loop. If ANY are interested, the Manager processes them.
         To keep it simple and compliant with the text "Otherwise he calls the next customer", 
         we will use a Multi-Instance Task for calling customers, and a Gateway after.
    -->
  </bpmn:process>
  
  <!-- Redefining Process for Strict Compliance and Clarity using Multi-Instance -->
  <bpmn:process id="LeadProcessingProcessCorrected" name="Lead Processing Process" isExecutable="true">

    </bpmn:task>

        <bpmn:dataState id="State_1" />
      </bpmn:dataState>
    </bpmn:dataObject>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckInterest" name="Is someone interested?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Seq_5</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Seq_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendNoteToManager" name="Send note to Manager">

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoInterest" name="No Interest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Seq_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManagerProcessesLead" name="Manager processes the lead">
      <bpmn:incoming>Seq_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Seq_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Processed" name="End">

    </bpmn:endEvent>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Seq_1" sourceRef="Start_1" targetRef="Task_CheckOpenLeads" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Seq_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckOpenLeads" targetRef="Task_SelectTopFive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Seq_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectTopFive" targetRef="Task_InstructAssistant" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Seq_4" sourceRef="Task_InstructAssistant" targetRef="Task_CallEachCustomer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Seq_5" sourceRef="Task_CallEachCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_CheckInterest" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Seq_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckInterest" targetRef="End_NoInterest" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Seq_7" sourceRef="Task_ManagerProcessesLead" targetRef="End_Processed" />
  </bpmn:process>
